subject: Call recap: CareFlow cost sensitivity + commitment options
messages: Subject: Call recap: CareFlow cost sensitivity + commitment options

Sophie / Ben — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and the asks I promised to follow up on from our discovery:

What I heard
- Production use: customer support summarization + agent responses (peak concurrency for morning digest).
- Current pilot: ~50k messages/day, ~3M tokens/day in the test environment. Expected growth to between 6M–15M tokens/day over next 6–9 months depending on feature rollout.
- Critical constraints: latency under 300ms p50 for short replies, and a hard budget target for unit cost (~$X/1M tokens) to make this viable across 50k customers.

Items I'm asking you to confirm (so we can size discounts):
1) Target budget bucket / $ per 1M tokens that would make a committed program attractive for you (ballpark is fine).
2) Whether you can consider a 6–12 month committed volume (if so, approximate monthly burn).
3) Priority for founder/early-stage credit vs straight committed discount (we can mix both).

Next steps from our side
- I attached a short worksheet to capture current pilot burn and 3 growth scenarios (CareFlow_Monthly_Usage.xlsx).
- If you confirm a target $/1M and a preferred commitment term, I’ll loop in Aditya to draft a quick commitment term with 2–3 discount bands and a founder credit option.

If easier, reply with the three bullets above and I’ll turn it into a one-pager for legal/finance.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0139

Attachment: CareFlow_Monthly_Usage.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38KB)
Subject: Re: Call recap: CareFlow cost sensitivity + commitment options

Irene — thanks for the tidy recap. Confirming answers below so you can proceed:

1) Target unit economics
- Our acceptable ceiling to move forward with committed pricing is $750 per 1M tokens. Below $600 is ideal and would make committed terms a no-brainer.

2) Commitment term
- We can realistically lock to a 9–12 month committed spend if the monthly burn can start at ~120M tokens/month and increase to ~350M by month 9 (aggressive growth scenario). We’d be comfortable with a ramp schedule.

3) Founder credit vs committed discount
- Founder/early-stage credit is attractive as a short-term incentive (1–3 months) but for us the long-term discount on committed volume is the priority. We’d like to see a mix: a small founder credit to offset initial trials plus a tiered committed discount for predictable pricing.

Also attaching our internal forecast (high level) — happy to sync with Aditya and Lauren if needed.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Martin
Head of Product, CareFlow
+1 (646) 555-1212

Attachment: CareFlow_Forecast_Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)
Cc: Ben Foster <ben.foster@careflow.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Subject: Re: Call recap: CareFlow cost sensitivity + commitment options

Perfect — really helpful. I’ll do the following by Monday:
- Build two term options: (A) 9-month ramped commit with tiered discounts sized to hit $600/$550/$500 per 1M at higher bands, (B) 12-month multi-year incentive with a modest founder credit (first 2 months free/credit).
- Include a soft SLA fallback and an escape clause for material usage variance >40%/mo.
- Send a one-page commitment summary + pricing table and a link to a DocuSign-ready term sheet.

Aditya / Lauren — looping you in to review pricing bands and confirm whether a founder credit of $25k in credits (applied over first 60 days) is approvable at our SDR/Seed tier, or if this needs leadership signoff. Also please confirm if we can offer a 6–8% incremental rebate for multi-year (12+ month) commits tied to milestone usage.

Sophie — would you be open to a 30-minute follow-up Tuesday to walk through the two options and pick one to move to legal? I can send calendar invites after Aditya confirms the bands.

Best,
Irene
Subject: Re: Call recap: CareFlow cost sensitivity + commitment options

Irene — thanks for the summary. Quick responses: 
- Founder credit: approved up to $20k credits at SDR/Seed tier without Exec escalation; for $25k we need sign-off from VP Sales. Let's aim to propose $20k and keep $5k contingent on legal/finance sign-off.
- Discount bands: finance is comfortable with the proposed structure that targets $600/$550/$500/1M at progressively larger bands, provided we have a minimum monthly committed volume clause (>=100M tokens/mo in month 1 ramp).
- Multi-year rebate: we can offer a 5% additional rebate for a 12+ month firm commitment (paid as credit on invoice quarterlies). More than 8% would need revenue ops approval.

Action items for me:
- I’ll draft a one-page commitment summary (Proposed_Commitment_Tiers.pdf) and route for legal review.
- Irene — if you can confirm the precise ramp schedule (month-by-month) Sophie mentioned, I’ll size the bands and share a DocuSign link by EOD Tuesday.

Aditya Rao
